discovery_source: Payments: per-rail reversal windows (Nacha R10/R29, card networks, UCC 4A)

Case completion never independently approves grants, clears charity/sanctions holds or releases payment. Provide My Work, My Accounts, Team Queue and Supervisor dashboard requirements; routine safe automated cases should not create unnecessary human tasks. **Acceptance (not executed):** ADV-619..ADV-654 and `HUMAN-WORK-QUEUES-ROUTING-OWNERSHIP-AND-CASE-CONTINUITY-2026-11-23.md`. business_objective: Consistent, explainable handling of conflicting instructions.
processing_rules: Instructions carry author, capacity, authority grant, scope (fund, recipient, amount, schedule) and authored time.
Two instructions conflict when their scopes overlap and their effects cannot both be executed within available capacity or policy.

Same author, overlapping scope: the later instruction supersedes the earlier only after the author confirms the supersession; a standing recurring instruction is not cancelled implicitly by a new one-off recommendation.
Different holders with joint authority: apply the fund's declared mode (Any, Lead, AllRequired); with no declared mode use AllRequired (consistent with AUTH-I4).
Any instruction authored after the author's verified death/incapacity effective time is invalid; those authored between effective time and notice are flagged for review (AUTH-I3).
Succession plan versions: only the latest sponsor-approved version applies; unapproved later drafts are disclosed in the case but not applied.

original_text: ## REQ-X-038: Deterministic retention-policy engine and governed disposition (2026-11-23) **Proposed:** Enforce record preservation through one versioned, typed in-process Retention Policy component within the component monolith. Financial records and evidence have a nonwaivable seven-year minimum from an approved class-specific trigger; longer legal, sponsor, contractual, dependency and legal-hold obligations prevail. Unknown or stale safety facts block deletion. Preservation, access and disposition are distinct decisions. Expiration means EligibleForReview, not automatic purge. Hold matching covers existing/future linked records and serializes with disposition; independently approved disposition rechecks authoritative policy, hold and dependency versions immediately before a fenced, auditable storage action. AI may suggest classification, never shorten retention or authorize deletion. Expose reasons, provenance, archive integrity and legal/compliance controls. **Acceptance (not executed):** ADV-379..ADV-406 and `DETERMINISTIC-RETENTION-POLICY-ENGINE-HOLDS-AND-DISPOSITION-2026-11-23.md`. Test calendar clocks, multi-class precedence, unknown facts, hold/deletion races, policy migrations, object-store failures, backup and privacy conflicts. Counsel approval and technical ADRs required.
parent_capability: REQ-X-037: Enterprise document classification and retention matrix (2026-11-23)
why_no_predecessor: Existing requirement present but not testable as written.
business_problem: REQ-X-038 and RR-REQ-X-036-r1 ('Expiry MUST create a disposition review task') imply per-record human work, contradicting RCD-007's class-level batch recommendation and RCF-PLT-014; defensible disposition rests on consistent schedule application, not per-item review.
statement: Disposition MUST operate on DispositionBatches defined by (tenant, record class, retention trigger period) rather than per-record review. When records in a batch reach EligibleForReview, the retention engine MUST compute the batch, excluding records under hold, with Unknown facts, or with unexpired dependencies; one authorized records owner (not the requester) MUST approve the batch; execution MUST re-check holds and safety epochs per record in the same authoritative transaction and skip (not fail) any record newly held. Per-record human review MUST be required only for records flagged by a deterministic exception rule. Expired records not yet approved MUST remain preserved; deletion MUST never be automatic.
rationale: REQ-X-038 and RR-REQ-X-036-r1 ('Expiry MUST create a disposition review task') imply per-record human work, contradicting RCD-007's class-level batch recommendation and RCF-PLT-014; defensible disposition rests on consistent schedule application, not per-item review.
evidence: https://www.thesedonaconference.org/sites/default/files/publications/Commentary%20on%20Legal%20Holds%20Second%20Edition%20extended%20PC%20period_0.pdf (accessed 2026-11-23; search-result summary; marked superseded, verify current edition)

business_objective: One driver set shared by planning and runtime attribution.

original_text: **UNB-EVT-001:** Maintain a governed event catalog with owner, schema, version, producer, authorized actor, consumer, control, evidence and side-effect classification for every event.
statement: The governed event catalog MUST record, for every event type: owning module; authority class (authoritative-financial, authoritative-nonfinancial, derived, informational, observation-ai); source-of-truth store; required consistency with the state it describes (synchronous or eventual); ordering scope (per aggregate, per fund, per sponsor ledger commit position, global hold version, or none); idempotency key formula; correction pattern; tenant scoping; retention class; producers; consumers; and crosswalk to equivalent names in other catalogs. A consumer that issues a consequential command MUST NOT be subscribed to an event whose authority class is derived, informational or observation-ai unless that command re-reads the authoritative fact in its own transaction; CI MUST reject such subscriptions.
reason_for_change: The existing catalog fields do not say whether an event may be acted upon or whether it is the truth, so informational and AI events can gate money.
business_objective: Prevent any consequential action being taken on a non-authoritative event.
processing_rules: Catalog entry incomplete -> build fails
Consequential handler subscribed to non-authoritative event without authoritative re-read -> build fails
Names in GR-EVT, TVR-EVT-001 and Echelon outputs mapped in crosswalk column
failure_behavior: Unknown authority class treated as informational (cannot gate)
security: Catalog changes are reviewed like code.
auditability: Catalog versioned; event-matrix.jsonl is the seed instance.
industry_analogy: Payments: distinguishing advisory messages (pacs.002 status) from booking entries
business_problem: Events of different authority are indistinguishable to consumers.
rationale: The existing catalog fields do not say whether an event may be acted upon or whether it is the truth, so informational and AI events can gate money.

acceptance_criteria.then: build fails with NON_AUTHORITATIVE_GATE

security_compliance: Catalog changes are reviewed like code.
api_implications: Catalog published as machine-readable file consumed by CI.
priority_justification: Gates on wrong authority class move money incorrectly.
decision_rationale: Convention cannot be enforced; catalog field can.

original_text: **UNB-EVT-005:** State-changing events with legal/financial consequences SHALL be emitted only by approved deterministic rules or authorized people, not raw probabilistic agent output.
statement: The F# domain model MUST define distinct types Observation (any source including AI; no authority), Proposal (a suggested command with evidence; no authority), Command (an authenticated principal's request) and Fact (an authoritative recorded outcome). Fact values MUST be constructible only inside owning-module command handlers (private constructors) after deterministic validation of an authorized Command. The AI workbench principal MUST be able to create only Observation and Proposal records, and its database role MUST hold INSERT only on the ai_observation schema. An AI Observation MAY influence a Fact only through an EvidencePromoted record created by a deterministic validator or an authorized human principal, which the Fact then cites.
reason_for_change: UNB-EVT-005 states the outcome without an enforcement mechanism; type and privilege separation make the prohibition structural.
business_objective: AI-generated content never becomes an authoritative financial or legal record by assertion.
processing_rules: AI tool calls map to ProposeX endpoints only
Promotion records cite observation id, promoter and validation rule
Fact tables have FK to evidence.facts, never to ai_observation
failure_behavior: AI write to fact table -> permission denied + security incident
Proposal executed without authorized command -> rejected
security: Separate DB role per principal class.
auditability: Every promoted evidence item traces to observation, model version and promoter.
industry_analogy: Model risk management: model outputs are inputs to decisions, not booking entries
business_problem: Nothing structurally stops AI output from being appended as a fact.
rationale: UNB-EVT-005 states the outcome without an enforcement mechanism; type and privilege separation make the prohibition structural.

acceptance_criteria.given: AI agent proposes clearing a sanctions hold
acceptance_criteria.then: no Fact created; hold remains; reviewer sees proposal (SIM-22)

acceptance_criteria.given: AI extracts EIN from a charity letter
acceptance_criteria.when: validator matches EIN to IRS file and promotes
acceptance_criteria.then: EligibilityEvaluationCompleted cites EvidencePromoted, which cites the observation

failure_conditions: Any fact without an authorized command lineage
security_compliance: Separate DB role per principal class.
testing_requirements: Type-level compile test; DB privilege test; prompt-injection fixture.
priority_justification: Prevents AI from becoming an unauthorized financial writer.
decision_rationale: Structural enforcement preferred over review.

original_text: **UNB-DATA-004:** Current state SHALL be computed as a deterministic projection of immutable authoritative records. Projection caches, materialized views, search indexes and read replicas MAY be rebuilt or replaced, but are explicitly non-authoritative. Their updates do not constitute modification of the append-only record.
statement: Records MUST be classified into storage classes. (1) Authoritative financial and authority facts (journal, reservations, grant/payment/contribution decisions, holds, policy versions, authority grants) MUST be append-only; their current state MAY be maintained in current-state tables updated in the same transaction as the fact append and MUST be deterministically rebuildable from the facts. (2) Engagement and relationship data (contact details, preferences, interactions, notes) MAY be stored as mutable rows with system-versioned history and is not required to be rebuildable from events; it is eligible for privacy redaction. (3) Operational coordination state (outbox delivery status, process-manager step and timers, leases, work-queue assignment) MAY be updated in place with audit of material transitions and is not authoritative. Projections, caches and search indexes remain non-authoritative as originally stated.
reason_for_change: Applying projection-of-immutable-records to every record class forces event sourcing where no replay need exists, conflicts with erasure and with the outbox.
business_objective: Keep replayable history where financial or legal reconstruction needs it, and simple storage elsewhere.
processing_rules: Every table declares its storage class
Class (1) tables: no UPDATE/DELETE grant
Class (2): history table populated by trigger or temporal mechanism
Class (3): never read by a release gate except outbox dispatch claim
security: Erasure applies to class (2) and to PII vault references, never to class (1) financial amounts.
auditability: History of class (2) retained per R-PII.
industry_analogy: Core banking + CRM + messaging middleware each with their own persistence semantics
business_problem: One persistence rule for all record kinds.
rationale: Applying projection-of-immutable-records to every record class forces event sourcing where no replay need exists, conflicts with erasure and with the outbox.

acceptance_criteria.then: both prior values with timestamps returned; current row updated in place

acceptance_criteria.when: rebuild runs from journal and reservations
acceptance_criteria.then: identical current state

security_compliance: Erasure applies to class (2) and to PII vault references, never to class (1) financial amounts.
priority_justification: Shapes the whole persistence design; mis-scoping costs build effort and privacy compliance.
decision_rationale: Universal ES rejected on cost and privacy; see Alternative comparison.
open_questions: Owner confirmation that UNB-DATA-001 'facts' excludes engagement and coordination data

original_text: **UNB-DATA-005:** Corrections SHALL preserve the original, correction reason, authorized corrector, linked evidence and effect on derived balances, grants, filings and notices. Financial corrections SHALL use balanced reversal/adjustment entries, never silent journal mutation.
statement: The system MUST maintain a versioned correction impact registry that maps each correctable fact type to the derived records computed from it (e.g., contribution valuation -> acknowledgment amount, Form 8283/8282 obligations, unit purchase, fee basis; NAV -> unit allocations, fee accruals, statements; journal batch -> snapshots, statements, Schedule D aggregates, capacity; payee destination -> pending payment intents). When a correction (reversal, re-post, restatement) commits, the system MUST deterministically enumerate impacted derived records as of the correction's effective date, create a linked task or automatic recomputation per registry rule (automatic only for deterministic recomputations such as fee delta postings; human for legal documents such as acknowledgments), and MUST NOT mark the correction case closed until every impacted item is resolved or explicitly waived with authority. Financial corrections continue to use balanced reversal/adjustment entries.
reason_for_change: UNB-DATA-005 states that effects on derived records are preserved but not how they are found or completed.
business_objective: Corrections leave no stale derived financial or legal records.
processing_rules: Registry entry per fact type
Impact enumeration is rule-based, not AI
Each impact item: recompute automatically, task, or waive
failure_behavior: Unmapped fact type correction -> case cannot close
auditability: Impact list stored on the case with evidence.
industry_analogy: Fund administration NAV-error correction processes (unverified — general industry knowledge)
business_problem: Corrections do not reliably propagate.
rationale: UNB-DATA-005 states that effects on derived records are preserved but not how they are found or completed.

acceptance_criteria.given: Contributed security valued on the wrong date; correction changes value from $52,000 to $49,800
acceptance_criteria.then: impact list includes acknowledgment amendment task, fee basis recompute delta posting, unit purchase adjustment and statement amendment for affected periods

acceptance_criteria.given: Correction case with one open impact item
acceptance_criteria.then: rejected IMPACTS_OPEN

security_compliance: Waivers require authority.
ai_automation: AI may summarise the impact list for the donor letter; enumeration is deterministic.
priority_justification: Prevents stale fees, units and tax documents after corrections.
decision_rationale: Registry is the machine form of the checklist.
